name: pulsed-auto-order
description: Watches a Pulsed Media WHMCS product and auto-orders it from account credit when it comes back in stock.

PM_COOKIE.description: REQUIRED. Logged-in WHMCS session cookie value (the login form is captcha-gated, so email+password cannot log in unattended). Get it from your browser devtools: cookie WHMCSmNqPBCNDcH8d.

PM_USERNAME.description: Preferred seedbox username. Fills the required Username custom field on the order form.

PM_DRY_RUN.description: true = walk up to checkout but never submit. Set to false to arm real ordering.

PM_PID.description: WHMCS product id. 355 = Eternal Vainamoinen - Seedbox 8TB R5 10G.

PM_BILLING_CYCLE.description: monthly, quarterly, semiannually, annually, biennially or triennially.

PM_MAX_TOTAL.description: Abort the order if the total due today exceeds this amount. 0 disables the cap.

PM_JITTER_SECONDS.description: Random extra delay added to each poll.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional. Telegram bot token for push notifications.

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Optional. Telegram chat id to notify.

PM_MODE.description: order = place the order automatically. cart = fill the cart and alert you to click Complete Order. auto = try to order, fall back to cart if checkout is captcha-gated.

PM_KEEPALIVE_SECONDS.description: How often to touch clientarea.php to keep the session alive.

PM_TARGET_TOTAL.description: Stop once the account holds this many services matching the product. Absolute and restart-safe: set to 2 if you already own one and want a second.
